description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the EmployeeLeaveEntitlementUsageLeaveReport API in the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. It defines test cases to verify the behavior of leave report API endpoints, including setup methods, data providers, and specific tests for getting leave report data with various conditions.

classes.name: EmployeeLeaveEntitlementUsageLeaveReportAPITest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class extending EndpointIntegrationTestCase, designed to test the LeaveReportAPI related to employee leave entitlement and usage reports within the OrangeHRM plugin system.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Initial setup executed once before all tests, populates test data from specified YAML fixtures.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the API's 'getOne' method with different input parameters, verifying correct data retrieval.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases for 'testGetAll' from a YAML data source.

methods.name: testGetAllWithLeavePeriodNotDefined
methods.description: Tests the API's 'getOne' method behavior when the leave period configuration is not defined.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAllWithLeavePeriodNotDefined
methods.description: Provides test cases for 'testGetAllWithLeavePeriodNotDefined' from a YAML data source.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Verifies that the delete method of the API throws a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Verifies that the validation rule for delete is not implemented and throws an exception.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Verifies that the update method of the API is not implemented and throws an exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Verifies that the validation rule for update is not implemented and throws an exception.
